summary: Add promptReceiptVersion: 1 and native prompt acceptance messageId, plus optional native McpInvocationMeta.toolCallId for exact tool-request joins, without inventing ask or terminal-event provenance.

Add capability-gated messageList and chatMessage public components sharing native Chat row, Markdown, timestamp, spacing and attachment presentation without changing the existing message body middleware contract.
Add Web v3 pageVersion: 1, declarative namespaced module pages and activation-scoped navigation through the existing host SPA router. Preserve legacy v2 and global component behavior.

Introduce Web v3 public components, generic owner-controlled durable drafts and explicit receipt reconciliation. Separate display message identity from native origin. Keep legacy Web v2 activation native-only without exposing generic drafts or double activation.

Add capability-gated role assignment permission and durable saved-selection notifications, explicit notification-only replay, a bounded passive session metadata directory, and the existing guarded session/load primitive to module host calls.

Add opt-in globalComponents and the globalComponentVersion capability for session-independent UI in the host React tree, with stable activation lifetimes and existing module failure/revocation ownership.

Expose canonical respondAsk and session/chat host calls with askResponseVersion and chatReadVersion capability checks, preserving native decision identity, passive reads, cursor expiry and bounded paging.
Add the settingsVersion capability and settings component middleware for module-owned sections in the host Settings dialog, preserving host controls, dialog ownership and module business boundaries.

Move backend and frontend contracts from the root to dedicated entry points. Generate wire types from the canonical protocol, including all preparation statuses. Make environment peers optional and verify isolated TypeScript 5.9.3 / React 18 and 19 consumption.
Allocate a new release identity after the unsuccessful initial publication and correct local tarball publication.
Introduce the standalone ESM and declaration SDK. This source change record does not establish registry publication.
